summary: The base source reproduced both reported control-flow defects in focused regressions. The patch temporarily enables pynccl for all-to-all and reserves symmetric memory before KV-cache budget profiling.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior: disabled pynccl took the torch.distributed path and symmetric-memory reservation was absent before KV profiling; 2 failed, 2 passed. Raw output: reports/j-3bed101271d1/raw/failing-before.txt

Passing-after behavior and boundary cases: temporary enable plus state restoration, already-enabled state preservation, no-pynccl fallback, and symmetric reservation before KV profiling; 4 passed. Raw output: reports/j-3bed101271d1/raw/passing-after.txt
Changed Python modules and regression test compile successfully.
Focused DCP unit suite plus the new regression: 21 passed and 18 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-3bed101271d1/raw/focused-suite.txt
Detected one AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2 and verified a simple GPU numerical sum (1240.0, matching the independent CPU reference). Raw output: reports/j-3bed101271d1/raw/gpu-probe.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-3bed101271d1/raw/gpu-probe.txt records one gfx950-class AMD Instinct MI350X and a matching GPU/CPU numerical result. This did not exercise multi-rank DCP.
